title: VideoGym: An Adaptive RL Environment for Long-Video Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains video agents to locate sparse evidence for long-video question answering through structured memory retrieval and temporal re-observation. This training, however, faces a long-tail modality distribution in the data. In our source pool, text-heavy questions account for 58% of samples, compared with 15% graph-heavy, 17% visual-heavy, and 10% time-range questions. Fixed-distribution RL therefore allocates fewer rollouts to underperforming question types. Reweighting these types could increase their sampling frequency but repeatedly reuses the same finite banks of original questions. To solve this problem, we introduce VideoGym, a curriculum-based RL environment that jointly constructs video-grounded training tasks and allocates rollouts among them. Within the environment, a memory-augmented VideoAgent is trained to coordinate retrieval from text, graph, and visual memories with temporal re-observation. Ac

translated_title: VideoGym：面向长视频智能体的自适应强化学习环境
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）通过结构化记忆检索和时间重观察来训练视频智能体，为长视频问答定位稀疏证据。然而，这种训练面临数据中的长尾模态分布问题。在我们的源池中，以文本为主的问题占样本的58%，相比之下，以图为主的问题占15%，以视觉为主的问题占17%，时间范围问题占10%。因此，固定分布的强化学习会为表现不佳的问题类型分配更少的训练回合。对这些类型重新加权可以增加其采样频率，但这会反复重用相同且有限的原始问题库。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VideoGym，一个基于课程学习的强化学习环境，它能够联合构建以视频为基础的训练任务，并在这些任务之间分配训练回合。在该环境中，一个增强记忆的VideoAgent经过训练，能够协调从文本、图和视觉记忆中的检索，并结合时间重观察。
tldr: VideoGym是一个基于课程的强化学习环境，通过联合构建以视频为支撑的训练任务并在任务间自适应分配训练回合，解决了长视频智能体训练中问题模态长尾分布导致的欠表现问题类型训练不足的难题。
en_tdlr: VideoGym is a curriculum-based RL environment that jointly constructs video-grounded training tasks and adaptively allocates rollouts among them, addressing the long-tail modality distribution problem in long-video agent training.
